events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has led to increased tensions in the Middle East, with potential implications for global oil supplies and prices. The US and its allies are considering further action, while Iran has threatened to retaliate. The conflict has already led to a surge in oil prices and volatility in financial markets.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG)

events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation has led to increased uncertainty and volatility in financial markets. The potential for further conflict and disruption to oil supplies has driven up oil prices and led to a flight to safety in assets such as gold and US Treasury bonds. However, the US stock market has also shown resilience, with the S&P 500 index holding up relatively well despite the tensions.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and Middle East tensions

events.exitStrategy: Exit if oil prices drop below $60/bbl or if a ceasefire is announced
